verdict.rationale: 2FAS explicitly points to its GitHub repository as source-available/open-source code ('Free, Open-source 2FA Authenticator App', 'Check out our GitHub repository') and describes it as verifiable by independent security experts, satisfying the ability to read source under an open license for the Auth app; Pass is described as source-available. Missing for 10: explicit license name/type (MIT/GPL/etc.) is not stated, and 2FAS Pass is only called 'source-available' rather than clearly 'open license', leaving some ambiguity for that product line.
